work_name: Tile Flooring and Polishing on existing Mosaic Flooring for the residential quarters Type -IV, Type-V at Hawalbagh. (SH: For Residential Qtr at VPKAS Hawalbagh Almora (UK).
location: Hawalbagh. (SH: For Residential Qtr at VPKAS Hawalbagh Almora (UK)
contractor_eligibility: Only the enlisted contractors of Class-III, IV and V by the Enlisting authority i.e. SDG (Chandigarh), ADG (Chandigarh), ADG (Lucknow), ADG (Jammu), ADG (DR) and ADG (PRD) shall tender within their limit and tendering jurisdiction i.e. Punjab, Chandigarh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Himanchal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Leh & Ladakh and Delhi of North region (NR), as per the Rules for enlistment of Contractors in CPWD, 2026. Further, the enlisted contractors of Class-III, IV and V shall also have to meet the other requirements of eligibility as per NIT conditions.
similar_work_criteria: The Contractor should have satisfactorily completed three similar works each of value not less than Rs. 11.91 lacs OR two similar work each of value not less than Rs. 17.87 lacs OR one similar work of value not less than Rs. 23.83 lacs in last 7 years ending last day of the previous month. Similar work would means “Work of Caretaking, Housekeeping and watch & ward and Similar work executed from any Holiday home/Guest house of Govt. of India who have minimum four years experience in Hilly area only having equivalent altitude or more in last seven years (Work experience certificate issued by the competent authority).” The value of executed works shall be brought to current costing level by enhancing the actual value of work at simple rate of 7% per annum, calculated from the date of completion to the last date of submission of tender.

boq_items.description: Hacking of CC flooring including cleaning for surface etc. complete as per direction of the Engineer-in- Charge.

Taking out existing wooden door shutter, repair by cut- ting, painting etc. and refixing of repaired door shut- ters to existing door frames, including replacement of hinges with screws, etc. as required, all complete as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge.
